hypothesis: Same-origin C2_B LR token-coefficient magnitudes can change A02 donor retrieval usefully beyond unchanged lexical TF-IDF cosine when the per-query correction mass is fixed to the original A02 mass.

arms.aligned: Token coefficient magnitude multiplier remains mapped by exact token identity into the original A02 vocabulary column order.
arms.permuted: Use the identical multiplier multiset permuted with numpy.random.default_rng(42).permutation, reset independently for each origin. This is an alignment diagnostic, not a formal randomization null.

lineage.a02_text_space: Exact same-origin saved A02 vectorizer; vocabulary-to-index mapping, all vectorizer parameters, and IDF array must match C2_B bitwise.
lineage.coefficient_source: Same-origin cached POSITIONAL_TEXT_PILOT_V1 C2_B BAG_LR fitted LogisticRegression with class order [0,1]. Extract coefficients from the verified structured + TF-IDF + missing-indicator assembly by exact token identity.
lineage.bank: Complete original A02 residual donor bank, saved OOF Sparse25 bank probabilities, observed residuals and cached original query baseline and top-32 similarities.
lineage.query_labels: Closed until all four candidate NPZ payloads have immutable hashes and the independent prelabel verifier returns PASS.

predictor.tfidf_weighting: Multiply each original A02 TF-IDF token column by d_j, then row-L2 normalize.
predictor.search: Top 32 positive weighted-cosine neighbors over the complete original donor bank; stable ties use official source row position.
predictor.mass_match: M0(q) = sum(original A02 top-32 cosine^2). For selected new donors u_i = new_cosine_i^2, use w_i = u_i * M0(q) / sum(u_i), so sum_i(w_i)=M0(q).
predictor.missing_or_zero_neighbor_fallback: Exact original A02 baseline prediction; missing rows must be bit-identical to A02.
predictor.positive_original_mass_without_new_suppo: Integrity failure; never silently fall back.

folds.pooled_unique: Concatenate E67 W4 (cycles 68-71) and E75 W6 (cycles 76-79), expected 13,441 unique rows, no overlap; retain each origin's own geometry map.

gates.advance_status: ADVANCE_TO_SOL_REVIEW only; no automatic continuation or champion change.

subgroups.unsupported: UNKNOWN; disclose support counts and do not estimate subgroup harm.

gates.failure: Any failed performance or integrity gate closes this exact lane; no post-hoc weighting rescue.

stop_boundaries: No full-Train refit, Kaggle access, submission, notebook change, teammate change, install, retry, or push.
All development windows reuse labels; E75 W6 overlaps E67 late rows and is not independent validation.
Send completed result or real blocker to KASDAD - TK2 - Sol before final user reply, then stop.
